newsitem.title: INDIA: India approves power plant capacity expansion.
newsitem.headline: India approves power plant capacity expansion.

text.p: India has approved a proposal of Videocon Power Ltd to hike its installed capacity to 1,050 megawatts (MW) from 1,000 MW, a government statement said on Thursday.
Earlier, the company was scheduled to set up two coal-based thermal power plants, each having a capacity of 500 MW. The revised capacity of each plant will now be 525 MW.
The cost of the project has now increased to 45.42 billion rupees from 43.20 billion, the statement said.
Videocon Power's foreign collaborator for the project is Edision Mission Energy of the U.S. which will contribute 6.13 billion rupees towards the total paid-up capital of 13.72 billion.
